idea-plugin.name: Claude Session Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Persist Claude Code sessions across terminal tabs in JetBrains IDEs. Keep multiple Claude sessions organized - each terminal tab remembers its session. Sessions auto-resume when you restart the IDE. Features:
  • Bind sessions to tabs automatically or manually
  • Auto-resume on IDE restart - every bound tab, no click needed
  • Session history per tab
  • Detects /clear, /compact, /resume changes
  • Per-project launch profile (extra Claude launch arguments)
  • Session registry (~/.claude/ide-events/sessions/) with idle/busy/waiting state for external tools
Setup: After installation, go to Settings > Tools > Claude Session Manager and click "Install Hooks" to enable session detection.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.8.0

  • New: session title sync in both directions. /rename (or --name) in a session renames its bound tab, persistently; renaming a tab in the IDE renames the session - typed as /rename while the session is idle, otherwise delivered with --name at its next resume or through the new tab-menu action "Push Tab Name to Claude Session". The "Sync Claude /rename to terminal tab name" setting now works; "Push IDE tab renames to the Claude session" is new.
  • New: registry files carry the session's Claude-side title as "title".
  • Changed: the launch profile rejects --name and -n; session naming belongs to the plugin.
  • Limitation: a /rename typed into a session whose prompt box holds an unsent draft submits the draft with it (only right after an IDE rename of an idle session).

0.7.0

  • New: per-project launch profile (Settings > Tools > Claude Session Manager > Launch Profile). Extra arguments are inserted on every launch in that project: auto-resume, context-menu resume, session history, new Claude tabs.
  • New: session registry for external tools. The hook script maintains one file per live session under ~/.claude/ide-events/sessions/ with its state (idle / busy / waiting on a permission prompt), working directory, pid, and the IDE project and tab the plugin bound it to. Reinstall the hooks from the settings page to enable it (the installer merges its entries next to other tools' hooks and never overwrites settings.json).
  • Fixed: after an IDE restart every bound tab now launches Claude, not only the selected tab of each project. Restored terminal tabs start their shell lazily on first display; the plugin now shows each restored tab once so the queued resume command runs.
  • Fixed: a session already running in another IDE or terminal is not resumed a second time. Auto-resume reads the session's registry file first and leaves the tab alone while its process is alive; the registry sweep keeps such files however old they are.
  • Fixed: the terminal-output channel no longer binds a tab to any session id that merely appears in its output. It now checks the session's working directory against the project, as the hook channel already did, so printing another session's id cannot rebind the tab or mislabel that session's registry file.
  • Fixed: registry project/tab are published for sessions confirmed only inside the auto-resume suppression window.
  • Fixed: project close keeps registry files of sessions live in another IDE; the same transcript is not resumed twice through two bindings' histories; the last SessionStart on the machine is not replayed into every project that opens.
  • Security: the launch profile rejects flags that load files or change permissions (--mcp-config, --settings, --permission-mode, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --allowedTools, --add-dir and relatives); tab names reaching notifications and tooltips are HTML-escaped; the hook script is installed atomically and never through a symlink.
  • Performance: the terminal-output scan no longer re-sorts the session index on the UI thread for every output chunk; the settings dialog no longer parses settings.json per keystroke.
  • Removed: the experimental Agent Teams module (dashboard, teammate tabs, settings page). Subagents are managed inside one session now.

0.6.6

  • Fixed: a tab that reuses an existing binding (reopened terminal matched by name, or a session change in an already bound tab) now gets the Claude icon and tab-title protection too. Without it such tabs stayed undecorated and Claude's terminal title renamed them freely.
  • Decoration is applied once per tab per IDE session instead of on every binding re-confirmation.

0.6.5

  • Fixed: hook events can no longer move a session away from the live tab that owns it. Multi-project resume storms fired each tab's SessionStart event at the selected tab (events arrive up to 90s after launch, outside any suppression window), overwriting unrelated bindings.
  • Fixed: duplicate-session cleanup now reverts the losing binding to its own session history when possible instead of deleting it.

0.6.4

  • Fixed: sessions are no longer skipped as "purged" when the binding's current id is an unpersisted resume fork (claude --resume forks the conversation under a new id; idle forks never reach disk). Resume now falls back through the binding's session history to the newest id with a transcript.

0.6.3

  • Fixed: the "Start new session" recovery action now binds the new session even when clicked during the startup suppression window (the target tab is pre-authorized; other tabs stay protected from resume-storm flip-flop).
  • Compatibility: title tracking flag resolved reflectively - it was removed from the platform in 2026.2. Verified compatible with 2026.1.6 and 2026.2.

0.6.2

  • Fixed: duplicate bindings pointing at the same session no longer send the resume command twice on startup (duplicates are cleaned up automatically).
  • Fixed: sessions whose conversation Claude Code already purged are no longer blindly resumed ("No conversation found"); a notification offers starting a fresh session in the same tab or removing the binding.
  • New: Claude's live progress is surfaced without renaming the tab - the bound tab keeps its name and colored Claude icon, gains a green activity badge while Claude works, and shows the current status as the tab tooltip.

0.6.1

  • Fixed: "Protect bound tab names" now works on the reworked terminal (2026.1). The reworked terminal applies Claude Code's title escape sequence without honoring the classic tracking flag, so protection is now enforced by clearing the application title whenever it reappears on a protected tab.
  • Settings hint: the IDE-wide Advanced Setting "Show application title" (terminal.show.application.title) disables these titles for all tabs.

0.6.0

  • Fixed: Session bindings are no longer lost after IDE restart. The stable tab id lives in tab UserData and dies with the IDE process; bindings are now re-attached to restored tabs via the terminal-persisted tab name (the name the terminal plugin itself stores and restores, which Claude Code's title takeover never touches).
  • Fixed: Auto-resume now waits for terminal tabs to finish restoring instead of declaring them missing after a fixed delay.
  • New: "Protect bound tab names" setting (default on) - bound tabs ignore Claude Code's terminal-title escape sequence IDE-side, so custom tab names stay put without changing Claude Code settings.
  • Improved: Bindings track the persisted tab name on user renames, keeping restart matching correct.

0.5.0

  • Fixed: Session bindings broke when Claude Code renamed terminal tabs (e.g. all tabs showing "Claude Code") on recent JetBrains builds. Tabs are now matched by a stable per-tab id instead of the volatile tab name, so renaming no longer loses bindings or causes cross-tab confusion.
  • New: One-time, idempotent migration of existing bindings to the stable-id model.
  • New: "Keep my custom tab names" setting that disables Claude Code's tab renaming (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE) for users who prefer their own names.

0.3.0

  • New: Agent Teams support - team dashboard, teammate terminal tabs
  • New: Team member navigation (Ctrl+Alt+T), dashboard toggle (Ctrl+Alt+D)
  • New: Task list and message log in team dashboard
  • New: Agent Teams settings page

0.2.0

  • New: Hook integration manager in settings (install/revert with transparency)
  • New: Settings action in context menu with "(action required)" indicator
  • Improved: Coroutine lifecycle and thread safety
  • Fixed: Memory leaks, date parsing, cache state issues

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • Basic session binding and management
